usedFor: Shopify holds the store's products, and Sightengine checks images through “Moderate Image Content” for unsafe content.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Moderate Image Content” in Sightengine
bestTemplate.why: Each new product can have an image scanned for unsafe or disallowed content.

watchOut: “Moderate Image Content” needs an image to scan, so map the product's image into the action.
